newsitem.title: USA: Avecor Q1 gross margin holds steady.
newsitem.headline: Avecor Q1 gross margin holds steady.

text.p: AVECOR Cardiovascular Inc said Tuesday that its gross margin was flat in the first quarter with the fourth quarter despite factory downtime, and has since improved.

"Gross margins, at 41.4 percent, were essentially unchanged from the fourth quarter despite downtime associated with our move to a new facility and a high volume of low-margin tubing pack business," chief executive Anthony Badolato said in a statement. "Since the move, we have experienced steady improvement in margins and, at quarter end, margins were running ahead of the fourth quarter level."
On Tuesday, Avecor reported first quarter earnings of $0.05 a share versus $0.03 a share last year.

Avecor said research and development expenses increased in the quarter, and marketing costs rose in preparation of the introduction of the Affinity blood pump. The pump will not produce revenue until later in the year, the company said.
"Although these expenses have a negative impact on current earnings, they really represent an investment in our future growth," Badolato said.

Research and development spending included the cost of European trials of the pump and testing proprietary coatings. The company said it expects to file for U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance early in the second half of the year.
